signals.title: Duplicate same-price sale events
signals.summary: Two adjacent sale events share the same price but disagree on date.
signals.recommendedAction: Verify canonical closing date before showing timeline.

signals.title: Owner role mismatch
signals.summary: The owner card and transaction chain point to different entities.

signals.title: Map marker hides value precision
signals.summary: The map marker shows exactly 1M while nearby markers preserve decimal precision.
signals.recommendedAction: Show one decimal above $1M unless the value rounds exactly to 1.0M.

signals.title: Exterior condition suggests repairs
signals.summary: Mock photo labels indicate worn exterior surfaces and possible deferred maintenance.

evidence.label: Photo tags
evidence.value: peeling paint, worn porch, overgrown yard

signals.recommendedAction: Request clearer exterior and roof photos before final pricing.

signals.title: Card status conflicts with detail view
signals.summary: The summary card says off market while detail signals imply an active investment workflow.
signals.recommendedAction: Use one canonical status source across card and detail views.

signals.title: Valuation confidence is moderate
signals.summary: Comparable signals are consistent enough to show an estimate with a confidence label.
signals.recommendedAction: Display with confidence language rather than as a precise fact.
